title: Healthy Kids Well-Child Reward
content:
# Healthy Kids Well-Child Reward

Healthy Kids rewards program terms — Medicaid Managed Care Membership, CHIP family premium months paid by the family.

## Term

The Healthy Kids well-child reward follows the child's well-child care: where the primary care visit record logs at least the well-child reward minimum of well-child visits in the reward look-back months before the review date and the current primary care practice is a Patient-Centered Medical Home Practice or Federally Qualified Health Center Home, the reward is the medical-home well-child amount; where that many well-child visits are logged and the practice is of any other type, the reward is the other-practice well-child amount; otherwise there is no well-child reward.

The reward is one of the Healthy Kids rewards credited on the premium month the family pays.

## Figures

| Item | Figure |
|---|---|
| Well-child reward minimum | 2 well-child visits |
| Reward look-back | the 12 months before the review date |
| Medical-home well-child amount | $3.00 |
| Other-practice well-child amount | $2.00 |

## Records read

The reward reads the child's Primary Care Provider Assignment: the visit log of well-child visits and their visit dates, and the practice type of the current (active) assignment. A Patient-Centered Medical Home Practice and a Federally Qualified Health Center Home count as medical-home practices; every other practice type — for example a Standard Primary Care Provider or a Pediatric Primary Care Provider — is of another type.

## Tiers

| Well-child visits logged in the 12 months before the review date | Current practice | Reward |
|---|---|---|
| 2 or more | Patient-Centered Medical Home Practice or Federally Qualified Health Center Home | $3.00 |
| 2 or more | any other type | $2.00 |
| 0 or 1 | any | no well-child reward |

## Cases (hypothetical)

- *Hypothetical:* 2 well-child visits logged in the look-back, current practice a Federally Qualified Health Center Home: $3.00.
- *Hypothetical:* 3 well-child visits logged, current practice a Pediatric Primary Care Provider: $2.00.
- *Hypothetical:* 1 well-child visit logged in the look-back and another logged earlier than that: only 1 counts, so there is no well-child reward.
